name: Doubled Fist
description: Throw a fist whose weight is doubled by gravity qi for the length of the stroke.

name: Lead Elbow
description: Drive an elbow that has been made as heavy as lead into the opponent's ribs.

name: Compact Guard
description: Make the guard dense with gravity so that a blow rebounds from it without making headway.

name: Measured Weight
description: Know at a touch how much extra weight a limb or a blow can bear before it fails.

name: Triple Mass
description: Treble the weight of a single strike at the moment of impact so it breaks a hardened guard.

name: Heap Weight
description: Cast heavy weight on the foe's weapon arm so it sags and the next attack cannot be thrown.

name: Pull Grip
description: Close a hand on a foe and set a line of pull that draws it back whenever it moves away.

name: Haul Palm
description: Haul the foe forward by its guard arm and strike its exposed centre with the open palm.

name: Clinging Guard
description: Hold a guard that pulls an attacking limb to rest against it and robs it of its swing.

name: Reel Step
description: Pull the user along a thread of qi tied to a fixed point and arrive at the foe's side.

name: Draw Aside
description: Pull a straight blow off its line with a sideways draw from the open hand.

name: Tether Drag
description: Fix a line of pull from the user's wrist to the foe's chest so it cannot back away.

name: Binding Pull
description: Pull the foe's limbs inward toward its own centre until it stands bound in a crouch.

name: Heavy Hand
description: Rest a heavy hand on the foe's chest and hold its qi too weighted to rise.

name: Anchor Palm
description: Strike with a palm that pins the target's footing to the ground at the moment of impact.

name: Planted Hold
description: Hold the feet to the ground with a steady pull so no push or throw can lift them.

name: Planted Step
description: Step and anchor in the same instant so the new stance carries no sway.

name: Nailing Weight
description: Set a weight on a foe's lead foot that holds it to the spot for a heartbeat.

name: Settled Eye
description: Sense where the ground gives and where it holds before the weight is set down.

name: Mooring Hold
description: Moor a foe to the ground so it cannot leap or fly while the hold is kept.

name: Immovable Stance
description: Become so heavy and so rooted that no ordinary push or throw can shift the user.

name: Load Fist
description: Load a fist with gravity and drive it down onto one spot on the foe's guard.

name: Pressing Guard
description: Press the guard down onto a blow so the attacking limb is forced toward the ground.

name: Weight Walk
description: Walk with measured heavy paces that make the ground beneath the foe feel unsteady.

name: Stone Weight
description: Hurl a small stone and add load in flight so it strikes with the force of a boulder.

name: Strain Reading
description: Find the point where a wall or a guard is bearing the most strain and will break first.

name: Point Load
description: Gather the weight of the whole body into one knuckle and drive it at a single spot.

name: Crushing Load
description: Pile weight on a single point of a guard until it buckles and the blow goes through.

name: Bowing Weight
description: Lay a growing weight on a foe's shoulders until it bows and cannot raise its head.

name: Pressing Wave
description: Drive a wave of gravity outward that presses every foe near the user down toward the ground.

name: Magnet Palm
description: Hold out a palm that draws a foe's metal gear against it so the hand is trapped.

name: Gathering Guard
description: Draw small missiles toward the guard and let them fall harmless at the feet.

name: Falling Toward
description: Fall toward a heavy object or wall as though it were down and arrive at it in a leap.

name: Core Pull
description: Draw a foe toward the user's centre as it is struck so the blow meets it twice.

name: Tide of Pull
description: Feel the ebb and flow of pull in a crowd and know which way weight is moving.

name: Small Centre
description: Make the user's chest a small centre of pull so that each blow lands with extra drag.

name: Lodestone Draw
description: Draw a foe and its drawn weapon toward the user's centre and hold them fast there.

name: Gathered Blows
description: Draw an incoming blow in toward the body and return it in a heavy short strike.
